answer: Each agent bonds 70 credits on a water tank. Each epoch it drops a violet feather plume and files ripple-arrival time at a ring on a public table. Violet dye marks its serial, so auditors re-drop the same plume and re-time the ripple; over 3% off or a copied time burns the bond. First filing costs 38, k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked. Rented-plume rings fail, each plume key-bound to one tank. Honest agents pay 38 once.
